title: SAP Business One Web Client UI API Common Schema
description: A base schema to define common parts(e.g. types, enums, event) for Web Client UI API. It is referenced by all other schemas.

b1.sdk.core.GUID.title: Control ID
b1.sdk.core.GUID.description: Control ID represented by a typical short uuid v4 (e.g. mApT49EtHH3qtUFeH3GGS3) or other stable unique ID.

procName.description: A function to handle the event.

before.description: A function to call before handling the event.

after.description: A function to call after handling the event.

b1.sdk.ButtonType.title: b1.sdk.ButtonType
b1.sdk.ButtonType.description: Different predefined button types for the b1.sdk.Button.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Back type (back navigation button for header)
Up type (up navigation button for header)

b1.sdk.ValueState.title: b1.sdk.ValueState
b1.sdk.ValueState.description: Marker for the correctness of the current value.
markdownEnumDescriptions: State is valid but with a warning

b1.sdk.InputType.title: b1.sdk.InputType
b1.sdk.InputType.description: A subset of input types that fits to a specific input format.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Support format like number1+unit1+number2+unit2, such as "1.234Lb11.000Oz"
There is a "%" behind the input area
Float format, with rounding accuracy setting for quantity
Float format, with rounding accuracy setting for rate
Float format, with rounding accuracy setting for unit

b1.sdk.TextDirection.title: b1.sdk.TextDirection
b1.sdk.TextDirection.description: Configuration options for the direction of texts.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Inherits the direction from its parent control/container

b1.sdk.TextAlign.title: b1.sdk.TextAlign
markdownEnumDescriptions: Locale-specific positioning at the beginning of the line
Locale-specific positioning at the end of the line
Sets no text align, so the browser default is used

b1.sdk.WrappingType.title: b1.sdk.WrappingType
markdownEnumDescriptions: Hyphenation will be used to break words on syllables where possible.
Normal text wrapping will be used. Words won't break based on hyphenation.

b1.sdk.MessageBoxAction.title: b1.sdk.MessageBoxAction
b1.sdk.MessageBoxAction.description: Enumeration of supported actions in a MessageBox. Each action is represented as a button in the message box.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Adds a "Cancel" button to the message box
Adds a "Close" button to the message box
Adds a "Delete" button to the message box
Adds a "Ignore" button to the message box
Adds a "No" button to the message box
Adds a "OK" button to the message box
Adds a "Retry" button to the message box
Adds a "Yes" button to the message box
Adds a "Abort" button to the message box

b1.sdk.MessageBoxType.title: b1.sdk.MessageBoxType
b1.sdk.MessageBoxType.description: Enumeration of supported MessageBox types with different icons.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Displays an error dialog with no icon
Displays an error dialog with an ERROR icon
Displays a success dialog with a SUCCESS icon
Displays a warning dialog with a WARNING icon
Displays a warning dialog with a INFORMATION icon
Displays a warning dialog with a CONFIRM icon

b1.sdk.MessageType.title: b1.sdk.MessageType
b1.sdk.MessageType.description: Enumeration of supported types of messages.

b1.sdk.SelectionMode.title: b1.sdk.SelectionMode
markdownEnumDescriptions: Select multiple rows at a time (toggle behavior)
Select one row at a time

b1.sdk.SelectionBehavior.title: b1.sdk.SelectionBehavior
markdownEnumDescriptions: Rows can be selected on the complete row.
Rows can only be selected on the row (and the selector is hidden).
Rows can only be selected on the row selector.

b1.sdk.HorizontalAlign.title: b1.sdk.HorizontalAlign
b1.sdk.HorizontalAlign.description: Configuration options for horizontal alignments of controls.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Locale-specific positioning at the beginning of the line
Locale-specific positioning at the end of the line

b1.sdk.FlexAlignItems.title: b1.sdk.FlexAlignItems
b1.sdk.FlexAlignItems.description: Determines the behavior of items along the cross-axis.
markdownEnumDescriptions: The flex item's margin edges are placed flush against the cross-start edge of the line
The flex item's margin boxes are centered in the cross-axis within the line
The flex item's margin edges are placed flush with the cross-end edge of the line
Inherits the value from its parent
The flex item's margin edges are placed flush with the cross-start edge of the line
The flex item's margin boxes are close to the same size as the line as possible

b1.sdk.FlexDirection.title: b1.sdk.FlexDirection
b1.sdk.FlexDirection.description: Determines the direction of child elements.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Flex items are laid out along the direction of the block axis (usually top to bottom)
Flex items are laid out along the reverse direction of the block axis (usually bottom to top)
Inherits the value from its parent
Flex items are laid out along the direction of the inline axis (text direction)
Flex items are laid out along the reverse direction of the inline axis (against the text direction)

b1.sdk.FlexJustifyContent.title: b1.sdk.FlexJustifyContent
b1.sdk.FlexJustifyContent.description: Determines the behavior along the main axis.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Flex items are packed toward the center of the line
Flex items are packed toward the end of the line
Inherits the value from its parent
Flex items are evenly distributed in the line, with half-size spaces on either end
Flex items are evenly distributed in the line
Flex items are packed toward the start of the line

b1.sdk.EmptyIndicatorMode.title: b1.sdk.EmptyIndicatorMode
b1.sdk.EmptyIndicatorMode.description: Modes in which a control will render empty indicator if its content is empty.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Empty indicator will be rendered depending on the context in which the control is placed
Empty indicator is rendered always when the control's content is empty

b1.sdk.MenuButtonMode.title: b1.sdk.MenuButtonMode
markdownEnumDescriptions: Default Regular type - MenuButton appears as a regular button, pressing it opens a menu
Split type - MenuButton appears as a split button separated into two areas

b1.sdk.PopupDock.title: b1.sdk.PopupDock
b1.sdk.PopupDock.description: Enumeration providing options for docking of some element to another.

b1.sdk.Wrapping.title: b1.sdk.Wrapping
markdownEnumDescriptions: Inserts actual line breaks in the text at the wrap point.
The standard browser behavior is considered for wrapping.
The text is actually on the same line but displayed within several lines.

b1.sdk.PageMode.title: b1.sdk.PageMode
markdownEnumDescriptions: Indicate the current view is in the state of creating a business object.
Indicate the current view is in the state of editing a business object.
Indicate the current view is in the state of viewing a business object.

b1.sdk.IndicationColor.title: b1.sdk.IndicationColor
b1.sdk.IndicationColor.description: Colors to highlight certain UI elements.
